This leads us (C)[expecting / to expect] that athletes would set new world records at the Olympics.
While these three thought experiments offer interesting possibilities, ⓐ그것들은 단지 상상력에 근거한 것이며 과학적 연구를 통해 시험되지 않았다는 것을 고려하는 것이 중요해.

윗글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ의 우리말을 아래와 같이 쓸 때, 주어진 <조건>에 알맞게 빈칸을 완성하시오.
<조건>
• ‘가주어-진주어‘ 구문을 사용할 것
• 명사절 접속사를 사용할 것
• 현재완료시제를 사용할 것
• <보기>의 단어 및 표현을 사용하되, 필요시 변형할 것
• 각 빈칸에 한 단어씩 쓸 것
<보기>
through, based on, imagination, scientific research, test, important, consider
______ ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ simply ______ ______ ______ and ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ ______
answer: it is important to consider that they are, based on imagination, have not been tested through scientific research
solution:
• ‘가주어-진주어’ 구문을 사용해야 하므로 it is와 ‘중요한’을 뜻하는 보어 important, 진주어 to consider를 차례대로 쓴다.
• to consider의 목적어 역할을 하는 명사절을 영작하기 위해 명사절 접속사 that과, that절의 주어 they를 쓰고 they(=experiments offer interesting possibilities)가 상상력에 ‘근거한’ 대상이므로 ‘base ~ on …(~을 …에 근거하다)‘의 수동태 be based on을 사용한다. 주어의 수일치하도록 be동사 are를 쓰고 simply 뒤에 based on, 목적어 imagination을 이어 쓴다.
• 주어 they가 ’시험되지 않은‘ 대상이므로 수동태를 써야 하며, 현재완료시제를 사용해야 하므로 등위접속사 and 뒤에 have not been tested를 쓰고, ’과학적 연구를 통해‘를 뜻하도록 수식어구 through scientific research를 이어 쓴다.

3. What if the oxygen concentration in the atmosphere doubled?
Oxygen is a vital gas for life, making up 21 percent of the Earth’s atmosphere. It is essential for breathing and is also necessary to burn common fuels like wood and oil to generate heat and light. Undoubtedly, it is an indispensable element for organisms on Earth. Then, would it be better to have a higher concentration of oxygen in the atmosphere? What would happen if the oxygen concentration were to double?
While more oxygen may seem beneficial, it could have ⓐunexpected consequences, especially for insects. Insects, such as bees and dragonflies, do not have lungs and instead take in air through external openings called spiracles. Although insects can survive without lungs, their spiracles are not as ⓑefficient as lungs at taking in air.
Therefore, with the current oxygen concentration, insects cannot evolve to be ⓒlarger than their current size. If they were bigger in size, oxygen would not be able to reach the deepest parts of their bodies. However, if the concentration of oxygen were to double, insects could grow in size as oxygen would be more ⓓreadily available. This increase in insect size could have a significant influence on the ecological environment, potentially ⓔstabilizing the food chain. Dragonflies, for example, may become as large as eagles, altering the balance of predators and prey in the ecosystem.

다음 글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중, 흐름상 어색한 것은?
solution: ⓔ stabilizing(안정화시키는) → disrupting(분열시키는)

by Emily Mitchell, Editor
In Isaac Asimov’s short story The Fun They Had, a young girl named Margie (A)[lives / living] in 2155 receives her education through a “mechanical teacher.” Her learning takes place one-on-one in her study next to her bedroom. One day, she finds a “real” book on traditional schools from hundreds of years ago and longs to receive a traditional education. She dreams of attending a real school (B)[where / which] all the students learn the same things, laugh and play on the playground, and go home together at the end of the day.
Margie’s desire reflects the ongoing debate on the merits of online education compared to (C)[that / those] of traditional education. As many of us already know, online education is instruction in electronically supported learning environments using multimedia and Internet platforms. Traditional education, on the other hand, generally refers to the conventional teaching-learning process in a classroom setting in which teachers and students are present together.
Which one do you think is better? We decided to explore this topic by considering the perspectives of our readers. The following represents two sides of the debate.
다음 글의 괄호 (A), (B), (C)에서 어법상 알맞은 말로 바르게 연결된 것은?
choices: lives / where / those
living / where / that
lives / which / that
living / where / those
living / which / those
solution:
(A) 뒤에 문장의 동사 receives가 있으므로, 분사구 named Margie에 이어 명사구 a young girl을 수식하는 분사 자리이다. 따라서 수식받는 명사구 a young girl이 2155년에 ‘사는’ 주체이자 live는 자동사이므로, 능동의 의미를 갖는 현재분사 living이 적절하다.
(B) 완전한 절(all ~ day)을 이끌어 장소를 나타내는 선행사 a real school을 선행사로 수식하는 관계사절을 이루어야 하므로 관계부사 where가 적절하다.
(C) 온라인 교육의 장점들(the merits of online education)과 전통적 교육(traditional education)의 장점들을 비교하고 있으므로 ‘장점들’을 뜻하는 복수명사구 the merits를 대신하는 복수대명사 those가 적절하다.

LETTERS TO THE EDITOR
Innovative Approaches for All Learners
Dear Editor,
Online education is definitely superior to traditional education. ㉠Living in an era which we enjoy technical innovations and boundless connectivity, we should take advantage of what is available in education as well. In the following, I will explore the reasons why online education is a better choice.
First, online education breaks down the barriers of time and space. Learners can access learning programs from anywhere and at any time. For instance, take Khan Academy, an online education program providing free lectures. It started when its founder, Sal Khan, uploaded teaching videos he made for his cousin who was living far away. Now learners from all around the world can enjoy the program’s outstanding lectures on a wide variety of subjects at any time they want.
Second, online education caters to personalized learning opportunities that meet the various needs of each learner. (A) One of the criticisms of traditional education is that it takes a one-size-fits-all approach that fails to address the various needs of students. (B) In contrast, online learning can offer a customized learning path for each learner. (C) Based on the assessment, each learner is offered personalized online lessons and more detailed explanations when necessary. (D) This kind of personalized feedback process can be highly interactive and motivate learners to reach higher levels of achievement. (E)
Finally, online education uses advanced technology such as multimedia materials or virtual simulations to provide more engaging and impactful learning experiences. For example, students can learn history more effectively by using virtual reality programs, ㉡which can show them realistic details of famous historical sites or allow them traveling back in time.
Advances in technology can make education so much better. Learning anywhere and at any time and receiving personalized lessons can make learning more effective and rewarding. It is evident that the future of education lies in online education.
Best regards,
Ethan Williams

㉠ ______ → ______

answer:
㉠ which → in which 또는 when
㉡ traveling → to travel
solution:
㉠ Living으로 시작하는 분사구문에서, 명사구 an era(시대)를 선행사로 수식하는 완전한 절(we ~ connectivity)을 이끌고 있으므로 관계대명사 which가 아니라 관계부사 또는 ‘전치사+관계대명사’의 형태로 고쳐야 한다. 따라서 시간을 나타내는 선행사를 갖는 관계부사 when 또는 in which로 고친다.
*본문에는 in which가 쓰였음
㉡ 콤마 뒤에서 주어가 없는 불완전한 절을 이끄는 계속적 용법의 주격 관계대명사 which가 이끄는 관계사절에서, 동사 allow는 ‘…가 ~하게 하다’의 의미의 5형식으로 쓰일 때 to부정사를 목적격보어로 취하므로, traveling을 to부정사 to travel로 고친다.

“Teaching and learning is the relationship between teachers and students,” Larry Cuban, an education expert from Stanford University, once explained. No matter what advanced technology it is equipped with, it is undeniable ⓐwhat online education focuses mainly on delivering information. It overlooks ⓑthat education is deeply rooted in the teacher-student relationship, which traditional education is based on. The following will demonstrate the strengths of traditional education in contrast to online education.
First, traditional education has proven ⓒmore successful in providing an educational environment where students can concentrate and learn better. According to a study on students’ level of concentration and understanding in traditional classrooms and online classes, students in traditional classrooms performed better. ㉠함께 학습하고 있기 때문에, 학생들이 주의를 기울이고 전통적 교실에서 배우는 내용을 이해하는 것이 훨씬 더 쉬운 것으로 보입니다.
Traditional education also fosters the development of students’ social and interpersonal skills. Beyond classroom instruction, students interact during their lunch breaks and extracurricular activities. While spending time together and being engaged in various types of interaction, students are exposed to valuable opportunities to learn how ⓓto communicate with each other. Consequently, students acquire essential social skills such as collaboration, conflict resolution, and leadership.
Finally, traditional education offers hands-on and practical learning opportunities. Subjects such as lab sciences and vocational training rely heavily on experiments and direct guidance from instructors. For instance, in a biology class, students learn how to handle a microscope, and ⓔobserve the shape of a cell through a microscope for the first time will present them with a truly engaging experience. Online platforms may provide simulations and virtual tools, but they cannot fully substitute the hands-on experiences offered by traditional classrooms.
In short, effective learning requires meaningful relationships between teachers and students, as well as among peers. This interpersonal connection represents the main advantage of traditional education. ⓕGuided by strong relationships, students can concentrate better, acquire interpersonal skills, and enjoy hands-on learning experiences. Traditional education makes all of this ⓖpossibly.
윗글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓖ 중, 어법상 어색한 것의 개수는?
choices: 1개
2개
3개
4개
5개
solution:
어색한 것은 총 3개이다.
ⓐ what → that (완전한 절(online ~ information)을 이끌어 가주어 it에 상응하는 진주어절을 이루어야 하므로 what을 명사절 접속사 that으로 고친다.)
ⓔ observe → observing (뒤에 동사 will이 있으므로, 뒤의 the shape ~ time을 이끌어 주어부를 이룰 수 있는 동명사가 와야 한다. 따라서 동사원형 observe를 동명사 observing으로 고친다.)
ⓖ possibly → possible (‘…를 ~하게 만들다’의 의미를 갖는 5형식 동사 make는 ‘make+목적어+목적격보어’의 구조로 쓰이며, 목적격보어 자리에 부사는 올 수 없다. 따라서 makes의 목적어 all of this 뒤에 위치한 목적격보어가 되도록 부사 possibly를 형용사 possible로 고친다.)
오답
ⓑ 완전한 절(education ~ relationship)을 이끌어 동사 overlooks의 목적어 역할을 하는 명사절을 이루고 있으므로 명사절 접속사 that은 적절하다.
ⓒ 동사 prove는 보어를 취해 ‘~임을 증명하다’를 뜻하는 2형식 동사로 쓰였으므로, 보어 자리에 비교급 형용사 more successful이 쓰인 것은 적절하다.

It is certainly not easy to judge which form of education is better. Online education has advantages such as accessibility, personalized instruction, and innovative teaching materials based on advanced technology. Traditional education, on the other hand, provides a more dynamic learning environment, based on the relationships students and teachers build together.
At present, what seems to be the most effective approach to this debate is to take advantage of each method by combining them. For example, teachers in a traditional education environment can introduce personalized online programs using AI technology or make use of VR as part of their classroom activities. Combining methods this way can benefit students by making up for what seems to lack in each method. Selecting the best resources and methods for learners will lead us to the most successful and fulfilling educational outcomes.

How to Choose the Better Option Between Online and Traditional Education
The Advantages and Disadvantages of Online and Traditional Education

첫 번째와 두 번째 단락에서 온라인 교육이 전통적인 교육보다 우수하다며, 시간과 공간의 제약을 없애 학습자가 언제 어디서나 학습 프로그램에 접근할 수 있다는 장점을 제시한다. 세 번째 단락에서 온라인 교육이 주로 정보를 전달하는 데 집중하며 교사와 학생의 관계가 교육에서 갖는 중요성을 간과하는 반면 전통적 교육은 그 관계에 기반을 두고 있음을, 네 번째 단락에서 전통적 교육이 온라인 수업보다 학생들의 집중력과 이해력을 높이는 데 더 효과적임을 설명한다. 따라서 온라인 교육과 전통적 교육이 각각 가진 장점을 대조하여 설명하는 글이므로 이 글의 주제로 ① ‘온라인 교육과 전통 교육의 장점의 대조’가 적절하다.
오답
② 전통적인 교육과 온라인 교육이 갖는 유사성과 차이점
③ 전통적인 교실 환경에서 시간과 공간의 장벽을 줄이기 위한 전략
④ 현대의 학습 환경에서 교사와 학생 간의 관계가 쇠퇴하고 있는 이유
⑤ 학습 결과를 극대화하기 위해 다양한 교육 방법의 이점을 활용하는 것

At present, what seems to be the most effective approach to this debate is to take advantage of each method by combining them. For example, teachers in a traditional education environment can introduce personalized online programs using AI technology or make use of VR as part of their classroom activities. (A)이런 식으로 방법들을 결합하는 것은 각 방법에서 부족해 보이는 것을 보완함으로써 학생들에게 유용할 수 있다. Selecting the best resources and methods for learners will lead us to the most successful and fulfilling educational outcomes.
다음 글의 밑줄 친 (A)의 우리말을 아래와 같이 쓸 때, 주어진 <조건>에 알맞게 빈칸을 완성하시오.
<조건>
• 동명사를 두 번 사용할 것
• 관계대명사 what을 사용할 것
• <보기>의 단어 및 표현을 사용하되, 필요시 변형할 것 (한 단어는 중복 사용 가능함)
• 각 빈칸에 한 단어씩 쓸 것
<보기>
make up for, lack, benefit, combine, can, in, seem, method
→ ______ ______ this way ______ ______ ______ by ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ ______.
answer: Combining methods, can benefit students, making up for what seems to lack in each method
solution:
• ‘방법들을 결합하는 것’을 뜻하도록 combine을 동명사로 변형한 Combining과 목적어 methods를 쓴다. 조동사 can과 ‘~에게 유용하다’를 뜻하는 동사 benefit, 목적어 students를 차례대로 쓴다.
• ‘~함으로써’를 뜻하도록 전치사 by의 목적어 자리에 ‘~을 보완하다’를 뜻하는 구동사 make up for를 동명사로 변형한 making up for를 쓴다.
• making up for의 목적어를 영작하기 위해 <조건>에 따라 ‘~한 것’을 뜻하는 관계대명사 what을 쓰고 ‘seem+to부정사(~처럼 보이다)’와 ‘lack(~이 부족하다)’를 결합한다. what을 단수 취급하여 seems to lack을 쓰고, ‘각 방법에서’를 뜻하도록 in each method를 쓴다.

body:
Second, online education caters to personalized learning opportunities that meet the various needs of each learner. One of the (A)[advantages / criticisms] of traditional education is that it takes a one-size-fits-all approach that fails to address the various needs of students. ⓐ______, online learning can offer a customized learning path for each learner. To achieve this, a computer learning program first assesses each learner’s current level and weaknesses. Based on the assessment, each learner is offered personalized online lessons and more detailed explanations when necessary. This kind of personalized feedback process can be highly interactive and (B)[motivate / forbid] learners to reach higher levels of achievement.
Finally, online education uses advanced technology such as multimedia materials or virtual simulations to provide more engaging and impactful learning experiences. ⓑ______, students can learn history more effectively by using virtual reality programs, which can show them realistic details of famous historical sites or allow them to travel back in time.
Advances in technology can make education so much better. Learning anywhere and at any time and receiving personalized lessons can make learning more effective and rewarding. It is (C)[unclear / evident] that the future of education lies in online education.
Best regards,
Ethan Williams
윗글의 괄호 (A), (B), (C)에서 흐름상 알맞은 말로 바르게 연결된 것은?
choices: advantages / motivate / evident
criticisms / forbid / unclear
criticisms / motivate / evident
advantages / forbid / evident
criticisms / motivate / unclear
solution:
(A) 전통적 교육이 학생들의 다양한 요구를 충족하지 못하는 천편일률적인 접근 방식을 취한다는 것은 전통적 교육의 단점을 의미하므로 criticisms(비판들)가 적절하다.
advantage 이점
(B) 학습자의 현재 수준과 약점을 평가한 후 이 평가에 기반하여 각 학습자들은 개인화된 온라인 수업을 받고, 필요할 때 더 자세한 설명을 제공받을 수 있으므로, 이러한 개인화된 피드백 과정은 학습자가 더 높은 성취 수준에 도달하도록 돕는다는 흐름이 자연스럽다. 따라서 motivate(동기를 부여하다)가 적절하다.
forbid 금지하다
(C) 온라인 교육의 장점을 설명하고 있는 글로, 기술의 발전이 교육을 훨씬 더 좋게 만들 수 있고, 언제 어디서나 배우고 개인 맞춤형 수업을 받는 것은 학습을 더 효과적이고 보람 있게 만들 수 있다는 내용에 이어지므로, 교육의 미래가 온라인 교육에 있다는 것이 명백하다는 흐름이 자연스럽다. 따라서 evident(명백한)가 적절하다.
unclear 불확실한, 분명하지 않은

Furthermore / In fact
On the contrary / As a matter of fact
In addition / For instance
However / Nevertheless
solution:

body:
In a place called Cottingley, England, in 1917, two young girls took some pictures of themselves near a stream at the bottom of a garden. The pictures showed the girls playing with fairies. (A) When the famous author of Sherlock Holmes, Sir Arthur Conan Doyle, found out about them, he wrote an article claiming that the pictures were proof of supernatural phenomena. (B) For several years, the girls maintained that the pictures were genuine. (C) Only after almost seventy years did the girls finally admit that the whole thing was made up. (D) While this story is an interesting anecdote of fake news involving a famous author, it may be a cautionary tale demonstrating the importance of media literacy in the digital age. (E)

In today’s words, one could say that the pictures went “viral,” and Doyle’s endorsement gave the pictures “credibility.”

윗글의 (A)~(E) 중, 주어진 문장이 들어갈 알맞은 곳은?
solution: 주어진 문장은 ‘오늘날 표현으로는, 그 사진들은 ‘입소문을 타고 퍼졌다’고 할 상황이었고, 도일의 지지는 이 사진들에 ‘신뢰성’을 부여해 주었다.’라는 뜻으로 이 문장 앞에는 the pictures(그 사진들)라고 지칭할 수 있는 특정 사진들이 언급되어야 하고, 도일이 그 사진들을 지지했다는 내용이 와야 한다. (A) 앞에서 소녀들과 요정들이 함께 있는 사진이 언급되었고, (B) 앞에서는 도일이 해당 사진을 초자연적 현상의 증거라고 주장하는 기사를 썼다고 설명하고 있다. 이는 사진이 널리 퍼지고 신뢰성을 얻는 계기가 되었음을 의미하므로 이 문장 뒤에 주어진 문장이 오면 자연스럽게 연결된다. 따라서 주어진 문장이 들어갈 알맞은 곳은 (B)이다.

(A) When the famous author of Sherlock Holmes, Sir Arthur Conan Doyle, found out about them, he wrote an article claiming that the pictures were proof of supernatural phenomena. (B) For several years, the girls maintained that the pictures were genuine. (C) Only after almost seventy years did the girls finally admit that the whole thing was made up. (D) While this story is an interesting anecdote of fake news involving a famous author, it may be a cautionary tale demonstrating the importance of media literacy in the digital age. (E)

윗글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?
choices: The two girls took pictures near a stream that appeared to show them playing with fairies.
Sir Arthur Conan Doyle was a famous author known for Sherlock Holmes.
For years, the two girls denied that the fairy pictures were staged.
Sir Arthur Conan Doyle publicly dismissed the pictures showing the girls playing with fairies as fake.
Decades later, the two girls finally admitted that the pictures were completely fake.
solution:
도일은 소녀들의 사진이 초자연적인 현상의 증거라고 주장하는 기사를 썼고 그의 지지가 사진에 신뢰성을 부여해 주었다고 했으므로 ④ ‘아서 코난 도일 경은 소녀들이 요정들과 함께 노는 모습을 보여 주는 사진들을 가짜라고 공개적으로 일축했다.‘는 일치하지 않는 내용이다.
오답
① 두 소녀는 자신들이 요정들과 함께 노는 모습을 보여 주는 것처럼 보이는 사진들을 개울 근처에서 찍었다.
② 아서 코난 도일 경은 셜록 홈스로 알려진 유명한 작가였다.
③ 두 소녀는 여러 해 동안 요정 사진들이 연출된 것이라는 사실을 부인했다.
⑤ 수십 년 후, 두 소녀는 마침내 그 사진들이 완전히 가짜였다고 인정했다.

body:
In the past, knowledge was passed down directly by the spoken word. The credibility of the speaker, not what was said, was the measure of trustworthiness. When the printing press introduced books as a means of knowledge transfer and written materials became more prevalent, readers had to develop new critical evaluation skills.
(A) Vertical reading involves relying on the text to determine the reliability or validity of information. In school, students learn to examine an author’s credibility, their logic, and their references based on only their text.
(B) However, they were often limited to a single source to evaluate the writer’s credibility, arguments, and logic. This type of analysis can be described as “vertical reading.”
(C) Having read a book, for example, a reader can review if the arguments presented in the text are supported by enough evidence, look at who the author or the publisher is, or check the references cited in the text.
However, technology has changed the landscape in which people write and publish, making it necessary to change reading strategies.

위 주어진 글에 이어질 순서로 알맞은 것은?
solution: 인쇄술의 발달로 책이 지식 전달의 수단이 되면서 독자들이 새로운 비판적 평가 능력을 개발해야 했다는 주어진 글 뒤에 앞 문장에서 언급된 readers를 they로 받고, 역접의 연결어 However(하지만)를 통해 그들이 저자의 신뢰성, 주장, 논리를 평가할 때 하나의 출처에 의존하는 경우가 많았다는 한계를 지적하는 (B), (B)의 마지막에서 처음 언급된 vertical reading(세로 읽기)의 개념을 설명하고, 학교에서 학생들이 글만을 바탕으로 저자의 신뢰성, 논리, 참고 자료를 검토한다고 언급하는 (A), For example(예를 들어)을 통해 책을 읽은 독자가 주장의 근거, 저자나 출판사, 참고 자료를 확인하는 방법을 구체적인 예시로 제시하는 (C)로 이어지는 흐름이 자연스럽다.

body:
In the past, knowledge was passed down directly by the spoken word. The credibility of the speaker, not what was said, was the measure of trustworthiness. When the printing press introduced books as a means of knowledge transfer and written materials became more prevalent, readers had to develop new critical evaluation skills.
(A) Vertical reading involves relying on the text to determine the reliability or validity of information. In school, students learn to examine an author’s credibility, their logic, and their references based on only their text.
(B) However, they were often limited to a single source to evaluate the writer’s credibility, arguments, and logic. This type of analysis can be described as “vertical reading.”
(C) Having read a book, for example, a reader can review if the arguments presented in the text are supported by enough evidence, look at who the author or the publisher is, or check the references cited in the text.
However, technology has changed the landscape in which people write and publish, making it necessary to change reading strategies.

윗글을 읽고 답할 수 없는 질문은?
choices: What was considered the measure of trustworthiness in knowledge transfer in the past?
What development made written materials more common as a means of knowledge transfer?
What are three ways readers can evaluate a book’s reliability or validity?
Why has it become necessary for readers to change their reading strategies in modern times?
What reading strategy is recommended to overcome the limitations of vertical reading?
solution:
세로 읽기의 한계만 설명하고 이를 극복하기 위한 구체적인 읽기 전략은 제시하지 않았으므로 ⑤ ’세로 읽기의 한계를 극복하기 위해 어떤 읽기 전략이 권장되는가?’는 답할 수 없는 질문이다.
오답
① 과거에는 지식 전달에 있어서 무엇이 신뢰성의 척도로 여겨졌는가? (→화자의 신뢰성이다.)
② 어떤 기술의 발달로 인쇄물이 지식 전달 수단으로 더욱 보편화되었는가? (→인쇄기술 때문이다.)
③ 독자들은 책의 신뢰성이나 타당성을 평가하기 위해 어떤 세 가지 방법을 사용할 수 있는가? (→주장에 충분한 근거가 있는지 검토하고, 저자나 출판사가 누구인지 살펴보며, 글에 인용된 참고 자료를 확인하는 것이다.)
④ 현대에 독자들이 읽기 전략을 바꿀 필요가 생긴 이유는 무엇인가? (→기술이 사람들이 글을 쓰고 출판하는 환경을 변화시켰기 때문이다.)

body:
Since technology in 1917 was nowhere near as advanced as it is today, it’s (A)[understandable / incomprehensible] that a few pictures could convince a famous author as well as the general public of the existence of fairies. Does advanced technology prevent people from being fooled now? In fact, it may make ⓐ[it / that] even easier to get tricked. Many people today fall victim to hoaxes or accept false claims because they don’t know how to verify information.
This begs the question: How is it possible to verify such vast amounts of information? On the Internet, finding information is relatively (B)[challenging / easy], but ⓑ[verify / verifying] or validating it is not. In the past, there were publishing standards ⓒ[what / that] authors had to meet. Today, the Internet (C)[establishes / removes] the barriers to publishing for millions of people; however, it also makes it harder for readers to find reliable and valid information. In this environment, media literacy is more important than ever.

윗글의 괄호 (A), (B), (C)에서 흐름상 알맞은 말로 바르게 연결된 것은?
(A) (B) (C)
choices: incomprehensible easy removes
understandable easy establishes
incomprehensible challenging removes
understandable challenging establishes
understandable easy removes
solution:
(A) 앞에서 1917년의 기술은 오늘날만큼 발전하지 못했다고 했으므로, 몇 장의 사진이 유명 작가와 일반 대중까지 요정의 존재를 믿게 했다는 것은 이해할 만하다는 흐름이 자연스럽다. 따라서 understandable(이해할 만한)이 적절하다.
incomprehensible 이해할 수 없는
(B) 글의 후반부에서 인터넷이 독자들이 신뢰할 수 있고 타당한 정보를 찾는 일을 더 어렵게 한다고 했으므로 인터넷에서 정보를 찾는 것이 상대적으로 쉽지만 그것을 검증하거나 타당성을 확인하는 것을 그렇지 않다는 흐름이 자연스럽다. 따라서 easy(쉬운)가 적절하다.
challenging 힘든, 어려운
(C) 상반된 내용을 연결하는 연결어 however 뒤에 이어지는 절에서 인터넷으로 인해 독자들이 신뢰할 수 있고 타당한 정보를 찾는 일이 더 어려워진다고 했으므로 앞에서 인터넷이 많은 사람들에게 출판의 장벽을 없애 준다는 흐름이 자연스럽다. 따라서 removes(~을 없애다)가 적절하다.
establish ~을 세우다, 쌓다

body:
Since technology in 1917 was nowhere near as advanced as it is today, it’s (A)[understandable / incomprehensible] that a few pictures could convince a famous author as well as the general public of the existence of fairies. Does advanced technology prevent people from being fooled now? In fact, it may make ⓐ[it / that] even easier to get tricked. Many people today fall victim to hoaxes or accept false claims because they don’t know how to verify information.
This begs the question: How is it possible to verify such vast amounts of information? On the Internet, finding information is relatively (B)[challenging / easy], but ⓑ[verify / verifying] or validating it is not. In the past, there were publishing standards ⓒ[what / that] authors had to meet. Today, the Internet (C)[establishes / removes] the barriers to publishing for millions of people; however, it also makes it harder for readers to find reliable and valid information. In this environment, media literacy is more important than ever.

윗글의 괄호 ⓐ, ⓑ, ⓒ에서 어법상 알맞은 말로 바르게 연결된 것은?
ⓐ ⓑ ⓒ
choices: it verifying that
that verifying what
it verify what
that verify that
it verifying what
solution:
ⓐ 뒤에 진목적어 역할을 하는 to부정사구 to get tricked가 있으므로 이에 상응하는 가목적어 it이 적절하다.
ⓑ 뒤에 동사 is가 있으므로 주어 역할을 하는 준동사 자리이며 등위접속사 or로 동명사 validating과 병렬로 연결되어야 하므로 동명사 verifying이 적절하다.
ⓒ meet의 목적어가 없는 불완전한 절(authors had to meet)을 이끌어 선행사 publishing standards를 수식하는 관계사절을 이루어야 하므로 목적격 관계대명사 that이 적절하다. what은 선행사를 포함하는 관계대명사로 선행사 뒤에 사용하지 않는다.

body:
Vertical reading is still useful, but new strategies must be adopted to navigate the vast online world. One of these strategies is called “lateral reading,” which involves verifying information while reading by checking as many sources as you can. This is useful because only one source is not enough. Checking information from multiple sources with various types of content, such as text, images, and videos, is helpful to verify something you have read and gain insight.
For example, suppose a student reads an article on a popular online news site about the health of a population of people. ⓐ빈약한 식단으로 입원한 사람들의 수에 관한 어떤 통계를 접하고 나서, 그녀는 간단히 브라우저의 또 다른 하나의 탭을 열어 해당 수치를 검증하기 위해 여러 다른 출처에 접속함으로써 가로 읽기 전략을 활용할 수 있다. In fact, she can open up as many new tabs as she wants to verify any type of information being presented, such as statistics in charts and tables, or general assertions. She can look up information from other popular news sites or go directly to a scientific journal article to read from the primary source of information.

다음 글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ의 우리말을 다음과 같이 쓸 때, 주어진 <조건>에 알맞게 문장을 완성하시오.
<조건>
• 완료형 분사구문을 사용할 것
• 관계대명사 who를 사용할 것
• <보기>의 단어 및 표현을 사용하되, 필요시 변형할 것
• (1), (2) 모두 각각 13단어로 영작할 것
<보기>
in, by, tab, different sources, some statistics, access, hospitalize, come across, simply open up
→ (1) ______ due to poor diet, she can employ the lateral reading strategy (2) ______ to verify the numbers.
answer:
(1) Having come across some statistics about the number of people who are hospitalized
(2) by simply opening up another tab in her browser and accessing different sources
solution:
• ‘통계를 접한 것’이 그녀가 가로 읽기를 활용할 수 있다는 주절의 내용보다 먼저 일어난 일이므로 (1)은 <조건>에 제시된 완료형 분사구문으로 써야 한다. 의미상 주어인 she가 ‘접하는’ 주체이므로 ‘~을 접하다’를 뜻하는 구동사 come across를 능동을 나타내는 완료형 분사 Having come across로 변형하고, 목적어 some statistics와 수식어 about the number of people을 이어 쓴다.
• 복수명사 people을 수식하는 관계사절을 영작하기 위해 <조건>에 제시된 관계대명사 who을 사용한다. hospitalize는 ‘~을 입원시키다’라는 뜻의 타동사이며 선행사인 people은 ‘입원하게 된’ 대상이므로 관계사절의 동사 자리에 수동태 are hospitalized를 이어 쓴다.
• ‘간단히 브라우저의 또 다른 하나의 탭을 열고 여러 다른 출처에 접속함으로써‘를 뜻하도록 by+동명사(구)(~함으로써)’를 사용하여 전치사 by와 simply opening up, 목적어 another tab과 수식어 in her browser를 차례대로 쓴다. 등위접속사 and를 쓰고 동명사 opening과 병렬이 되도록 access를 동명사로 변형하고 목적어 different sources를 이어 쓴다.

body:
Readers employing digital lateral reading can take advantage of the volume of information on the Internet to check the credibility of an author’s claims. They can utilize Internet browser tools that help review many sites simultaneously. Many people and companies currently use this reading strategy because it allows them to more easily cross-check data, distinguish opinions from facts, and evaluate claims efficiently.
As a way to maintain credibility, some companies hire “fact-checkers” to evaluate their writers’ claims before publishing anything. These fact-checkers use lateral reading as a quick means to survey what has already been written. For example, imagine a news agency that wants to publish a story on its website about a merger between two corporations. Fact-checkers will cross-check information from a variety of sources to ensure that the facts are accurate. In fact, in recent research surveys, having utilized this strategy, participants were found to have a broader understanding of any kind of information than participants who had used less optimal strategies like vertical reading.

다음 글의 주제로 알맞은 것은?
choices: conflicting online reports that make it difficult to reach conclusions
the necessity of hiring professional editors to write research papers
improving access to digital content through advanced technology
the effectiveness of lateral reading in efficiently verifying online information
the challenges of training professional fact-checkers to evaluate corporate mergers
solution:
가로 읽기를 통해 여러 웹사이트의 정보를 비교하고, 의견과 사실을 구분하며, 주장의 신뢰성을 효율적으로 평가할 수 있다고 설명하고, 사실 확인자가 다양한 출처의 정보를 교차 확인하여 사실의 정확성을 검증하고, 이 전략을 활용한 사람들이 더 폭넓게 정보를 이해했다고 언급하고 있으므로 이 글의 주제로 ④ ‘온라인 정보를 효율적으로 검증하는 데 있어 가로 읽기의 효과’가 적절하다.
오답
① 결론에 도달하기 어렵게 만드는 상충하는 온라인 보도들

body:
Vertical reading is not a perfect strategy and neither is lateral reading, but lateral reading takes greater advantage of modern technology than vertical reading. To fully appreciate this strategy, a reader in the digital world makes evaluating all forms of information a habit. ⓐNo matter how neutrally an author or publication claims to be, the burden of evaluation falls upon the reader to survey as much information as possible to determine the credibility of the data or the claims. We need to understand that the world, and therefore information itself, is constantly evolving: information does not remain still, ⓑso neither the reader should. For this reason, lateral reading is a continuous, repetitive process. Instead of approaching media from the perspective of a mere consumer of information, readers must learn to actively and dynamically engage with it while trying to make sense of it.

윗글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ, ⓑ에서 어법상 어색한 부분을 찾아 각각 알맞게 고쳐 쓰시오.
어색한 표현 → 알맞게 고친 표현

ⓑ ______ → ______
answer:
ⓐ neutrally → neutral

solution:
ⓐ no matter how가 이끄는 양보의 부사절은 「no matter how+형용사/부사+주어+동사」의 어순으로 써야 하며, how 뒤에는 be동사 be의 보어 역할을 하는 형용사가 필요하므로 neutrally는 neutral로 고친다.
ⓑ 접속사 so 뒤의 절에서 ‘~도 …아니다’를 뜻하는 부정어 neither가 절의 맨 앞에 쓰였으므로 주어와 동사가 도치되어야 한다. 따라서 the reader should를 should the reader로 고친다. 참고로 조동사 should 뒤에 앞 절과 반복되는 remain still이 생략되어 있다.

body:
In a place called Cottingley, England, in 1917, two young girls took some pictures of themselves near a stream at the bottom of a garden. The pictures showed the girls playing with fairies. When the famous author of Sherlock Holmes, Sir Arthur Conan Doyle, found out about them, he wrote an article claiming that the pictures were proof of supernatural phenomena. In today’s words, one could say that the pictures went “viral,” and (A)Doyle’s endorsement gave the pictures “credibility.” For several years, the girls maintained that the pictures were genuine. (B)거의 70년이 지나고 나서야 그 소녀들은 이 모든 것이 다 꾸며낸 일이었다고 마침내 인정했다. While this story is an interesting anecdote of fake news involving a famous author, it may be a cautionary tale demonstrating the importance of media literacy in the digital age.

윗글의 밑줄 친 (A)Doyle’s endorsement gave the pictures “credibility”가 의미하는 바로 알맞은 것은?
choices: Famous writers often use fictional stories to explain mysterious events.
A respected person's support can make unreliable information seem believable.
The popularity of photographs can serve as evidence of their authenticity.
Public interest in photographs can encourage further scientific investigation.
Ordinary people are better than experts at spotting manipulated evidence.
solution:
유명 작가인 도일이 요정 사진을 초자연적 현상의 증거라고 주장하는 글을 썼고, 그 사진이 널리 퍼졌으나 약 70년 후 조작된 것으로 밝혀졌다고 했으므로, 밑줄 친 부분은 ② ‘존경받는 사람의 지지는 신뢰할 수 없는 정보도 믿을 만한 것으로 보이게 할 수 있다.’를 의미한다.
오답
① 유명한 작가들은 종종 신비로운 사건들을 설명하기 위해 허구의 이야기들을 사용한다.
③ 사진의 인기는 그 사진들이 진짜라는 증거가 될 수 있다.
④ 사진에 대한 대중의 관심은 추가적인 과학적 조사를 촉진할 수 있다.
⑤ 일반 사람들은 조작된 증거를 발견하는 데 전문가들보다 더 능숙하다.

body:
In a place ⓐcalled Cottingley, England, in 1917, two young girls took some pictures of themselves near a stream at the bottom of a garden. The pictures showed the girls playing with fairies. When the famous author of Sherlock Holmes, Sir Arthur Conan Doyle, found out about them, he wrote an article ⓑclaiming that the pictures were proof of supernatural phenomena. In today’s words, one could say ⓒthat the pictures went “viral,” and Doyle’s endorsement gave the pictures “credibility.” For several years, the girls maintained that the pictures were genuine. Only after almost seventy years did the girls finally ⓓadmitted that the whole thing was made up. While this story is an interesting anecdote of fake news involving a famous author, it may be a cautionary tale ⓔdemonstrating the importance of media literacy in the digital age.

윗글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중, 어법상 어색한 것은?
solution:
ⓓ admitted → admit (only가 시간, 조건, 방법 등을 나타내는 부사구 또는 부사절과 함께 쓰이는 경우, 이어지는 주절의 주어와 동사가 도치되며, 여기서는 only 뒤에 시간의 부사구인 after almost seventy years가 이어지고 있으므로 ‘only+부사구+조동사(do/does/did)+주어+동사원형’의 어순으로 써야 한다. 따라서 did와 주어 the girls, 부사 finally에 이어지는 admitted는 동사원형 admit로 고친다.)
오답
ⓐ 명사구 a place를 수식하는 분사 자리이며, a place가 Cottingley라고 불리는 대상이므로 수동의 의미를 갖는 과거분사 called는 적절하다.
ⓑ 명사구 an article을 수식하는 분사 자리이며, an article이 ‘주장하는’ 주체이므로 능동의 의미를 갖는 현재분사 claiming은 적절하다.
ⓒ 완전한 절(the pictures went “viral“)을 이끌어 동사 say의 목적어 역할을 하는 명사절을 이루고 있으므로 명사절 접속사 that은 적절하다.
ⓔ 명사구 a cautionary tale(경고의 이야기)을 수식하는 분사 자리이며 수식을 받는 a cautionary tale이 ‘보여주는’ 주체이므로 능동의 의미를 갖는 현재분사 demonstrating은 적절하다.

Single-Source Reading

In the past, knowledge was passed down directly by the spoken word. The credibility of the speaker, not what was said, ⓐwas the measure of trustworthiness. When the printing press introduced books as a means of knowledge transfer and written materials became more prevalent, readers had to develop new critical evaluation skills. However, they were often limited to a single source to evaluate the writer’s credibility, arguments, and logic. This type of analysis can ⓑbe described as “vertical reading.”
Vertical reading involves relying on the text to determine the reliability or validity of information. In school, students learn to examine an author’s credibility, their logic, and their references based on only their text. ⓒHaving read a book, for example, a reader can review if the arguments presented in the text are supported by enough evidence, look at who the author or the publisher is, or ⓓcheck the references cited in the text. However, technology has changed the landscape ⓔwhich people write and publish, making it necessary to change reading strategies.

body:
Since technology in 1917 was nowhere near as advanced as it is today, it’s understandable that a few pictures could convince a famous author as well as the general public of the existence of fairies. (A) Does advanced technology prevent people from being fooled now? (B) Many people today fall victim to hoaxes or accept false claims because they don’t know how to verify information. (C) This begs the question: How is it possible to verify such vast amounts of information? (D) On the Internet, finding information is relatively easy, but verifying or validating it is not. (E) In the past, there were publishing standards that authors had to meet. Today, the Internet removes the barriers to publishing for millions of people; however, it also makes it harder for readers to find reliable and valid information. In this environment, media literacy is more important than ever.

In fact, it may make it even easier to get tricked.

윗글의 (A)~(E) 중, 주어진 문장이 들어갈 알맞은 곳은?
solution: 주어진 문장은 ‘사실, 그것은 오히려 더 속기 쉽게 만들 수도 있다.’라는 뜻으로 주어진 문장의 주어인 it이 (B) 앞의 advanced technology(첨단 기술)을 가리키고 있으므로 첨단 기술이 오늘날 사람들이 속는 것을 막아 주는지 질문하는 내용 뒤이자 사람들이 오늘날 많은 사람들이 정보를 검증하는 방법을 몰라 속임수의 피해자가 되거나 거짓 주장을 받아들인다는 내용 앞인 (B)에 들어가야 한다.

body:
Multiple-Source Reading

Vertical reading is still useful, but new strategies must be adopted to navigate the vast online world. One of these strategies is called “lateral reading,” (A)[which / that] involves verifying information while reading by checking as many sources as you can. This is useful because only one source is not enough. (B)[Checking / Check] information from multiple sources with various types of content, such as text, images, and videos, is helpful to verify something you have read and (C)[gains / gain] insight.
For example, suppose a student reads an article on a popular online news site about the health of a population of people. Having come across some statistics about the number of people who are hospitalized due to poor diet, she can employ the lateral reading strategy by simply opening up another tab in her browser and accessing different sources to verify the numbers. In fact, she can open up as many new tabs as she wants to verify any type of information being presented, such as statistics in charts and tables, or general assertions. She can look up information from other popular news sites or go directly to a scientific journal article to read from the primary source of information.

윗글의 괄호 (A), (B), (C)에서 어법상 알맞은 말로 바르게 연결된 것은?
(A) (B) (C)
choices: which Checking gains
that Checking gains
that Check gains
which Check gain
which Checking gain
solution:
(A) 주어가 없는 불완전한 절(involves ~ can)을 이끌어 콤마(,) 앞의 “lateral reading”을 부연 설명하는 관계사절을 이루어야 하므로 계속적 용법의 주격 관계대명사 which가 적절하다. that은 계속적 용법으로 사용할 수 없다.
(B) 뒤에 동사 is가 있으므로 이어지는 명사구를 목적어로 취하여 주어부를 이루는 준동사 자리이다. 따라서 동명사 Checking이 적절하다.
(C) 형용사 helpful을 수식하는 부사적 용법의 to부정사 to verify와 등위접속사 and로 병렬 연결되어야 하므로 to를 생략한 동사원형 gain이 적절하다. 이처럼 to부정사의 병렬구조에서 두 번째 to는 흔히 생략된다.

choices: T-F-T-F-F

solution:

body:
Readers ⓐemploying digital lateral reading can take advantage of the volume of information on the Internet to check the ⓑcredibility of an author’s claims. They can utilize Internet browser tools that help review many sites simultaneously. Many people and companies currently use this reading strategy because it allows them to more easily ⓒcross-check data, distinguish opinions from facts, and evaluate ⓓclaims efficiently.
As a way to maintain credibility, some companies hire “fact-checkers” to evaluate their writers’ claims before publishing anything. These fact-checkers use ⓔlateral reading as a quick means to survey what has already been written. For example, imagine a news agency that wants to publish a story on its website about a merger between two corporations. Fact-checkers will cross-check information from a variety of sources to ensure that the facts are accurate. In fact, in recent research surveys, (A)이 전략을 활용한 참가자들이 세로 읽기와 같이 덜 효과적인 전략들을 사용한 참가자들보다 어떤 정보든 더 폭넓은 이해를 하는 것으로 밝혀졌다.

윗글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ의 영영풀이로 알맞은 것을 모두 골라 짝지은 것은?
<보기>
ⓐ employ: to pay someone to work for you
ⓑ credibility: the fact that someone or something can be believed or trusted
ⓒ cross-check: to make certain that information, a calculation, etc. is correct, by asking a different person or using a different method of calculation
ⓓ claim: an official request for money that you think you have a right to
ⓔ lateral: going straight up or down rather than from side to side
solution:
ⓑ 신뢰성: 누군가 또는 무언가가 믿을 수 있거나 신뢰할 수 있다는 사실
ⓒ 교차 검토하다: 다른 사람에게 묻거나 다른 계산 방법을 사용하여 정보, 계산 등이 정확한지 확실히 하다
오답
ⓐ 이용하다, 쓰다: 누군가에게 당신을 위해 일하도록 돈을 지불하다
(→to use a particular object, method, skill etc in order to achieve something(무언가를 달성하기 위해 특정한 사물, 방법, 기술 등을 사용하다))
ⓓ 주장: 자신에게 권리가 있다고 생각하는 돈에 대한 공식적인 요청
(→a statement that something is true, even though it has not been proved(증명되지 않았음에도 불구하고 무언가가 사실이라는 진술))
ⓔ 옆의, 측면의: 좌우로가 아니라 똑바로 위아래로 향하는
(→relating to the sides of an object or plant or to sideways movement(물체나 식물의 측면 또는 옆으로의 움직임과 관련된))

윗글의 밑줄 친 (A)의 우리말을 다음과 같이 쓸 때, 주어진 <조건>에 알맞게 빈칸을 완성하시오.
<조건>
• 완료형 분사구문을 사용할 것
• 비교급을 사용할 것

<보기>
strategy, any kind, find, use, optimal, who, utilize, understanding, broad, have
→ ______ ______ ______ ______, participants ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ like vertical reading
answer: having utilized this strategy, were found to have a broader understanding of any kind of information than participants who had used less optimal strategies
solution:
• ‘이 전략을 활용한 것’이 ‘어떤 정보든 더 폭넓은 이해를 하는 것으로 밝혀진 것’보다 먼저 일어난 일이므로 <조건>에 따라 완료형 분사구문을 써야 하며, 의미상 주어인 participants가 이 전략을 ‘사용한’ 주체이므로 utilize를 having utilized로 변형하고 목적어 this strategy를 이어 쓴다.
• 주어 participants가 폭넓은 이해를 하는 것으로 ‘밝혀진’ 대상이므로 제시되어 있는 주절의 주어 participants 뒤의 동사구 자리에는 ‘be found+to부정사(~하는 것으로 밝혀지다)’를 사용하여 were found를 쓴다. ‘~에 대한 더 폭넓은 이해를 하다’를 뜻하도록 형용사 broad를 비교급으로 변형하여 to have a broader understanding of를 쓰고, ‘어떤 정보든’을 뜻하는 any kind of information과 비교 대상을 연결하는 than(~보다)를 이어 쓴다.
• than 뒤에 participants를 쓰고 participants를 선행사로 수식하는 관계사절을 <조건>에 따라 관계대명사 who를 사용하여 쓰고, ‘최근 연구 조사에서는 밝혀진 것’보다 ‘덜 효과적인 전략을 사용한 것’이 먼저 일어난 일이므로 동사 use를 과거완료형 had used로 변형하여 쓰고 목적어 less optimal strategies를 이어서 쓴다.

body:
Numerous surveys consistently highlight the growing trend of teenagers spending extensive hours on social media. This increased usage comes with potential risks, including addiction and exposure to misinformation and inappropriate content. Many adolescents struggle with managing their time and interactions on social media. To address these concerns, certain authorities are implementing legal restrictions on minors’ access to social media. For example, in some countries, like China, limits for social media have been put on children and teens. Also, in 2023, the state of Utah enacted two bills: one requiring parental consent for minors to create or (A)[maintain / maintaining] social media accounts and the other granting parents full access to their children’s online activities.
Despite these concerns, it is crucial (B)[maintain / to maintain] a balanced perspective that acknowledges the significant advantages that social media can offer. Social media provides an efficient platform for teenagers to express themselves, discover new friendships, and connect with like-minded individuals. Through sharing their thoughts, experiences, and talents, they can find a sense of empowerment and self-identity in the digital world. Research shows the benefits of social media in fostering peer connections and offering essential emotional support, particularly for teens who may lack such support within their local communities. Additionally, social media serves as a valuable tool for staying informed about current events and acquiring knowledge on various subjects, (C)[making / make] it an invaluable resource for research and problem-solving.
As we weigh these contrasting effects of social media, the question of whether regulating teenagers’ social media usage should remain a private or public matter is left open. This debate shows the fundamental tension between personal freedoms and societal interests, and it is one that continues to evolve with the ever-changing digital landscape. It is certainly worth reflecting on. Which side of this debate do you find yourself on, and what drives your perspective?

choices: maintaining maintain making

maintain to maintain making

(B) 가주어 it에 상응하는 진주어 자리이므로 to부정사 to maintain이 적절하다.

Although concerns about the risks of teenagers' social media use have led to ______ restrictions, social media also offers ______ such as self-expression, ______ support, and access to information, which raises the question of whether its regulation should be a ______ or ______ matter.
solution: [요약문] 십 대의 소셜 미디어 사용에 따른 위험성에 대한 우려가 법적 규제로 이어졌지만, 소셜 미디어는 자기표현, 정서적 지원, 정보 접근과 같은 이점들도 제공하며, 이는 소셜 미디어 사용에 대한 규제가 개인의 문제인지 공적인 문제인지에 관한 의문을 제기한다.

body:
ⓐ세로 읽기는 완벽한 전략이 아니며, 가로 읽기도 마찬가지지만, 가로 읽기는 세로 읽기보다 현대 기술을 보다 더 효과적으로 활용한다. To fully appreciate this strategy, a reader in the digital world makes evaluating all forms of information a habit. (A) No matter how neutral an author or publication claims to be, the burden of evaluation falls upon the reader to survey as much information as possible to determine the credibility of the data or the claims. (B) We need to understand that the world, and therefore information itself, is constantly evolving: information does not remain still, so neither should the reader. (C) For this reason, lateral reading is a continuous, repetitive process. (D) Furthermore, the rapid advancement of digital technology has enabled consumers to access a wider range of entertainment media than ever before. (E) Instead of approaching media from the perspective of a mere consumer of information, readers must learn to actively and dynamically engage with it while trying to make sense of it.

윗글의 밑줄 친 (A)~(E) 중, 흐름상 관계없는 문장은?
solution: 디지털 시대에 정보의 신뢰성을 판단하기 위한 가로 읽기와 독자의 능동적인 정보 평가 자세를 설명하는 글이다. (A)는 정보의 신뢰성을 판단할 책임이 독자에게 있음을 강조하고, (B)는 정보가 끊임없이 변화한다는 점을 언급하며, (C)는 이에 대응하기 위해 가로 읽기가 지속적이고 반복적인 과정이어야 함을 설명하고, (E)는 독자가 정보를 수동적으로 소비하는 데 그치지 않고 능동적으로 탐색하고 이해해야 함을 강조한다. 그러나 (D) ‘게다가, 디지털 기술의 급격한 발전은 소비자들이 그 어느 때보다 더 광범위한 엔터테인먼트 미디어에 접근할 수 있게 해주었다.’는 비판적 정보 검증 및 가로 읽기와는 무관하므로 글의 흐름과 관계없다.

윗글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ의 우리말을 <조건>에 알맞게 영작하시오.
<조건>
• 도치구문을 사용할 것
• 비교급을 사용할 것
• <보기>의 단어 및 표현을 사용하되, 필요시 변형할 것
• 24단어로 영작할 것
<보기>
neither, perfect, but, take great advantage, vertical, modern, strategy, lateral, and
→ ______
answer: Vertical reading is not a perfect strategy and neither is lateral reading, but lateral reading takes greater advantage of modern technology than vertical reading.
solution:
• 세로 읽기가 완벽한 전략이 아니라는 의미인 절인 ‘Vertical reading is not a perfect strategy’을 먼저 쓴 다음 등위접속사 and로 ‘~도 … 아니다’라는 뜻의 neither를 사용하여 완전한 절을 병렬구조를 이루도록 쓴다. 도치구문을 사용하라는 <조건>에 따라 부정의 neither를 가장 먼저 쓰고 「neither+동사+주어」의 어순을 이루도록 써야 한다. 주어가 단수명사구인 lateral reading이고 앞 절의 be동사가 쓰였으므로, is와 lateral reading을 차례대로 쓴다.
• 접속사 but 뒤에 주어 lateral reading을 쓰고, ‘take advantage of ~(~을 활용하다)’와 great의 비교급을 사용하여 ‘을 보다 더 효과적으로 활용한다’를 뜻하도록 takes greater advantage of를 이어 쓴다. takes greater advantage of 뒤에 목적어 modern technology와 ‘세로 읽기보다’를 뜻하는 vertical reading을 이어 쓴다.

body:
In the past, knowledge was passed down directly by the spoken word. The credibility of the speaker, not what was said, was the measure of trustworthiness. When the printing press introduced books as a means of knowledge transfer and written materials became more prevalent, readers had to develop new critical evaluation skills. However, they were often limited to a single source to evaluate the writer’s credibility, arguments, and logic. This type of analysis can be described as “vertical reading.”
Vertical reading ______ to determine the reliability or validity of information. In school, students learn to examine an author’s credibility, their logic, and their references based on only their text. Having read a book, for example, a reader can review if the arguments presented in the text are supported by enough evidence, look at who the author or the publisher is, or check the references cited in the text. However, technology has changed the landscape in which people write and publish, making it necessary to change reading strategies.

involves relying on the text

body:
In a place called Cottingley, England, in 1917, two young girls took some pictures of themselves near a stream at the bottom of a garden. The pictures showed the girls playing with fairies. When the famous author of Sherlock Holmes, Sir Arthur Conan Doyle, found out about them, he wrote an article claiming that the pictures were proof of (A)[natural / supernatural] phenomena. In today’s words, one could say that the pictures went “viral,” and Doyle’s endorsement gave the pictures “credibility.” For several years, the girls maintained that the pictures were (B)[fake / genuine]. Only after almost seventy years did the girls finally admit that the whole thing was made up. While this story is an interesting anecdote of fake news involving a famous author, it may be a cautionary tale (C)[demonstrating / undermining] the importance of media literacy in the digital age.

다음 글의 괄호 (A), (B), (C)에서 흐름상 알맞은 말로 바르게 연결된 것은?
(A) (B) (C)
choices: supernatural genuine undermining
natural fake demonstrating
supernatural fake undermining
supernatural genuine demonstrating
natural genuine demonstrating
solution:
(A) 사진은 소녀들이 요정들과 함께 노는 모습을 담고 있었다고 했으므로 초자연적인 현상이라는 흐름이 자연스럽다. 따라서 supernatural(초자연적인)이 적절하다.
natural 자연의
(B) 뒤에서 거의 70년이 지난 뒤 소녀들이 모든 것이 다 꾸며낸 일이었다고 인정했다고 했으므로 이 사진들이 진짜라고 주장했다는 흐름이 자연스럽다. 따라서 genuine(진짜의)이 적절하다.
fake 가짜의
(C) 두 소녀가 사진을 조작하고 유명 작가의 주장이 사진에 신뢰성을 부여하여 사람들이 이를 믿게 되었다고 했으므로, 이것이 디지털 시대에 미디어 리터러시가 중요하다는 점을 보여 준다는 흐름이 자연스럽다. 따라서 demonstrating(보여주는)이 적절하다.
undermine ~을 약화시키다

Plants are amazing. Throughout their long existence, they have created diverse survival strategies. Seeds, in particular, are one of the strongest survival (A)[technique / techniques] they have developed. Let’s discover the fascinating and mysterious world of seeds.

Jackfruit, the world’s largest tree fruit, has a sweet smell that attracts animals, similar to pineapples and bananas. It tempts animals (B)[eating / to eat] delicious fruit flesh, thereby getting them to eat the seeds. The fruit flesh is digested by the animals that consume it, but the seeds are not digested and (C)[pass / passing] through the animals’ digestive tracts untouched. When these animals poop out the seeds, the seeds begin to sprout and grow, and jackfruit spreads. In exchange for a satisfying meal, the animals spread the jackfruit seeds.

techniques eating passing

techniques to eat passing
solution:

(B) ‘~가 …하도록 꾀다’라는 뜻으로 ‘tempt+목적어+to부정사(구)’를 사용하므로, tempts와 목적어 animals 뒤에 to부정사인 to eat가 알맞다.
(C) but 뒤에 이어진 절에서 주어 the seeds에 이어진 첫 번째 동사구 are not digested와 등위접속사 and에 의해 병렬로 연결되어 있으며, pass는 ‘통과하다’라는 뜻의 자동사로 쓸 수 있으므로, 복수명사구인 주어에 수일치한 능동태 복수동사 pass가 알맞다.

body:
Out of numerous creative methods for spreading seeds, silver arrow-reed in South Africa has a particularly unique one. Silver arrow-reed spreads its seeds by deceiving dung beetles. Dung beetles, by nature, roll antelope dung and bury it in the ground to eat or lay eggs in. Silver arrow-reed seeds are dark brown, round, and slightly larger than 1 cm in size. Their visual appearance and smell are quite similar to antelope dung. So when a seed falls onto the ground, dung beetles will approach the fallen seed within minutes. Then, they carefully roll the seed away as if it were antelope dung. That is why dung beetles are often spotted rolling silver arrow-reed seeds that look and smell like dung balls. When they try to eat the seeds or lay eggs inside of them, however, the confused beetles will realize they cannot. They have no choice but to abort and search for real dung balls. By tricking dung beetles into rolling away and burying the seeds, silver arrow-reed is able to spread and plant its seeds better.

다음 글의 제목으로 알맞은 것은?
choices: How Antelope Dung Helps Plants Grow in the Wild
The Diet and Nesting Habits of Dung Beetles in South Africa
The Visual Similarities Between Seeds and Animal Waste
Why Dung Beetles Struggle to Find Real Antelope Dung
Silver Arrow-Reed‘s Tricks to Spread Seeds by Fooling Dung Beetles

As these fruits dry, they become solid, and their hooks become tough enough ⓒattaching to the bodies of animals.
As animals pass by, the hooks ⓓextending in all directions will keep the dried fruit firmly attached to their fur. As the animals move away, the seeds from the fruit will be scattered in various locations. The attached hooks cause severe pain to the animals, ⓔmake them feel like the devil is scratching them with its horrifying claws. That is how devil’s claw became ⓕknown as the worst free rider.

<기호> <알맞게 고친 표현>
(1) ______ → ______
(2) ______ → ______
(3) ______ → ______
solution:
ⓑ 주어 Its blossoms에 대한 동사로 transform이 있으므로 주어를 수식하는 분사구를 이루는 분사 형태가 되어야 한다. 주어가 ‘(~을) 닮은’ 주체이며 뒤에 목적어로 명사구 pink trumpets가 있으므로, 동사 resemble을 현재분사 resembling으로 고친다. 참고로, ‘~을 닮다, ~와 비슷하다’라는 뜻으로 상태를 나타내는 타동사 resemble은 수동태나 진행형으로 쓰이지 않는다.
ⓒ ‘~하기에 충분히 …한/…하게’라는 뜻으로 ‘형용사/부사+enough+to부정사’가 쓰이므로, 형용사 tough와 부사 enough 뒤의 attaching을 to부정사인 to attach로 고친다.
ⓔ 동사(cause)가 있는 완전한 절(The attached hooks cause ~ animals)에 접속사 없이 콤마(,)로만 다른 동사(구)가 이어질 수 없으므로, 분사구문을 이루는 분사 형태가 되어야 한다. 뒤에 목적어로 대명사 them이 있으므로, make를 능동을 나타내는 현재분사 making으로 고친다.
오답
ⓐ ’~하는 것을 선택하다‘라는 뜻으로 ’opt+to부정사‘를 사용하며, 뒤에 목적어로 명사구 their seeds가 있으므로, 동사 opt 뒤에 타동사 scatter(~을 흩뿌리다)의 to부정사인 to scatter는 알맞다.

body:
Plants will do anything to spread their seeds. They offer tasty food to animals in return for distributing their seeds. Jackfruit, the world’s largest tree fruit, has a sweet smell that attracts animals, similar to pineapples and bananas. It tempts animals to eat delicious fruit flesh, thereby getting them to eat the seeds. The fruit flesh is digested by the animals that consume it, but the seeds are not digested and pass through the animals’ digestive tracts untouched. When these animals poop out the seeds, the seeds begin to sprout and grow, and jackfruit spreads. ______

다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
choices: In exchange for a satisfying meal, the animals spread the jackfruit seeds.
In order to protect their seeds from predators, jackfruit trees produce fruit with an unpleasant smell.
By distributing the seeds away from the jackfruit tree, the animals help the seeds grow in new places.
Since animals cannot digest the jackfruit seeds, they spit out the jackfruit seeds before digesting the fruit.
To protect their seeds from being eaten, jackfruit trees develop a hard outer shell that makes the fruit difficult for animals to open.
solution:
세계에서 가장 큰 나무 열매인 jackfruit의 사례를 들어, 그 나무가 달콤한 향기로 동물들을 유혹하여 과육과 함께 씨앗을 먹게 하고, 씨앗이 과육과 달리 소화되지 않고 배변을 통해 밖으로 배출되어 발아하여 자라기 시작하며 jackfruit이 퍼져 나간다고 설명했으므로, 식물이 먹이를 제공한 대가로 동물들이 씨앗을 퍼뜨린다고 정리하는 흐름이 되는 ① ‘만족스러운 식사에 대한 대가로, 동물들은 jackfruit 씨앗들을 퍼뜨립니다.’가 빈칸에 알맞다.
오답
② 포식자들로부터 자신들의 씨앗을 보호하기 위해, jackfruit 나무는 불쾌한 냄새가 나는 열매를 만든다.
③ 씨앗을 jackfruit 나무에서 떨어진 곳에 퍼뜨림으로써, 동물들은 씨앗이 새로운 장소에서 자라도록 돕는다.
④ 동물들이 jackfruit 씨앗을 소화할 수 없기 때문에, 그들은 열매를 소화하기 전에 그 씨앗을 뱉는다.
⑤ 씨앗이 먹히는 것을 막기 위해, jackfruit 나무는 동물들이 열매를 열기 어렵게 만드는 단단한 겉껍질을 발달시킨다.

body:
Out of numerous creative methods for spreading seeds, silver arrow-reed in South Africa has a particularly unique ⓐone. Silver arrow-reed spreads its seeds by deceiving dung beetles. Dung beetles, by nature, roll antelope dung and bury it in the ground ⓑto eat or lay eggs in. Silver arrow-reed seeds are dark brown, round, and slightly larger than 1 cm in size. Their visual appearance and smell are quite similar to antelope dung. So when a seed falls onto the ground, dung beetles will approach the ⓒfallen seed within minutes. (A)그런 다음, 그들은 마치 그것이 영양의 배설물인 것처럼 씨앗을 조심스럽게 굴려서 갑니다. That is why dung beetles are often spotted ⓓrolling silver arrow-reed seeds that look and smell like dung balls. When they try to eat the seeds or lay eggs inside of them, however, the confused beetles will realize they cannot. They have no choice but ⓔaborting and search for real dung balls. By tricking dung beetles into rolling away and burying the seeds, silver arrow-reed is able to spread and plant its seeds better.

윗글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중, 어법상 어색한 것은?
solution:
ⓔ aborting → to abort (‘~할 수밖에 없다’라는 뜻으로 ‘have no choice[option/alternative/other way] but+to부정사’, ‘cannot help -ing’, ‘cannot help but+동사원형’ 등을 사용하므로, have no choice but 뒤에 to부정사가 이어져야 한다. 따라서 동명사 aborting을 to부정사인 to abort로 고친다.)
오답
ⓐ 관사 a와 ’부사+형용사‘ 형태의 형용사구 particularly unique 뒤에 단수명사 method를 대신해 쓰인 단수형 부정대명사 one은 알맞다.
ⓓ 수동태 동사구 are often spotted에 이어져 있으므로, 5형식인 ’spot+목적어+목적격보어(현재분사)(~가 …하는 것을 발견하다)‘의 수동태 ’be spotted+현재분사(…하는 것이 발견되다)‘를 이루는 현재분사 rolling은 알맞다.

body:
Not all seeds are transported by animals. Some are carried by the wind. This approach is used by maple trees.
(A) As a result, it can travel much farther from the parent tree. The rotation also slows down the speed of the fall, and the seed softly lands on the ground. This helps reduce the damage to the seed during the fall.
(B) It is similar to how helicopters get lifted and stay in the air using their propellers. The rotation caused by its wings allows the maple seed to elevate twice as high as non-rotating seeds.
(C) Maple seeds are shaped like a boomerang with irregular ridges on the surface. When a maple seed falls from the tree, it spins around. This rotation makes the seed stay in the air longer and fly farther.

위 주어진 글에 이어질 순서로 알맞은 것은?
solution: 모든 씨앗들이 동물들에 의해 이동되는 것이 아니라 일부는 바람에 의해 운반된다고 말하며 이러한 방법을 사용하는 사례로 단풍나무를 제시하는 주어진 글에 이어, 단풍나무 씨앗의 모양과 표면의 특징을 소개하며 씨앗이 나무에서 떨어질 때 회전을 하여 씨앗이 공중에 더 오래 머물고 더 멀리 날아갈 수 있다고 설명하는 (C), 앞서 언급한 단풍나무 씨앗의 회전을 It으로 가리켜, 그것이 헬리콥터가 프로펠러를 이용해 공중에 떠 있는 방식과 유사하다고 설명하며, 회전하지 않는 씨앗들보다 두 배 더 높이 올라갈 수 있음을 제시하는 (B), As a result(결과적으로)를 사용해 앞서 설명한 회전 작용의 결과 씨앗이 모체 나무로부터 훨씬 더 멀리 이동할 수 있고, 낙하 속도를 늦춰 씨앗이 부드럽게 땅에 착륙하게 한다고 설명하는 (A)로 이어지는 것이 알맞다.

body:
In most cases, mature seeds are automatically separated from the parent plant. However, some plants only release their seeds after enduring an extreme experience. Eucalyptus is one such example. Eucalyptus seeds are as ⓐtiny as grains of sand, but they are bound together in firm capsules. Birds cannot eat them because they are securely protected by a strong shell. In long periods of hot and dry weather, eucalyptus leaves rub together and naturally catch fire because the leaves contain highly ⓑflammable oil. The extreme heat from the fire causes the shell to ⓒcrack open. Finally, the seeds come out of the shell, hit the ground, and begin to grow. The fallen seeds are conveniently ⓓconcealed in the soft ash left over after the fire, which protects them from the harsh environment. Wildfire, often started by the parent tree, also burns practically everything on the ground, ⓔprotecting other plants that would compete with the seeds for the water and sunlight needed for growth. As you can see, eucalyptus is only able to reproduce provided that there is fire.

solution: ⓔ protecting(보호하는) → destroying(파괴하는)

ⓔ: are → is
solution:
ⓒ what → that (‘so+형용사’인 so overwhelmed가 있는 앞 절의 결과를 나타내는 완전한 절이 뒤에 이어지므로, ‘너무 ~해서 …하다’라는 뜻의 ‘so+형용사/부사+that+완전한 절(주어+동사 ~)’ 구문을 이루도록 what을 which가 아닌 that으로 고친다.)
ⓓ see → seeing (전치사 of의 목적어인 명사(구)나 동명사(구)를 이루어야 하며, 의미상 주어 you가 목적격의 형태로 앞에 쓰였으므로, see를 to see가 아니라 동명사 seeing으로 고친다. 참고로, 전치사의 목적어 자리에 to부정사(구)는 쓸 수 없으며, to부정사의 의미상 주어는 to부정사 앞에 ‘for+목적격/명사(구)’ 형태로 쓰고, 동명사의 의미상 주어는 동명사 앞에 목적격이나 소유격의 형태로 쓴다.)
오답
ⓐ 가주어 it에 대한 진주어 자리에 to부정사(구)가 와야 하므로, 동사 find를 to부정사인 to find로 고친 것은 알맞다.
ⓑ 동사가 있는 완전한 절(a redwood named Hyperion stands enormously tall)에 접속사 없이 콤마(,)로만 동사(구)가 이어질 수 없으므로 흐름상 동시동작(~하면서)을 나타내는 분사구문을 이루는 분사 형태가 되어야 하며, 주절 주어와 동일한 분사구문의 의미상 주어 a redwood named Hyperion이 타동사 reach(~에 이르다)의 주체이고 뒤에 목적어로 over 115 m가 이어져 있으므로, reached를 능동을 나타내는 현재분사 reaching으로 고친 것은 알맞다.
ⓔ 주어 The height difference between Hyperion and its neighboring redwoods 뒤에 a few meters를 보어로 하는 be동사가 올 자리이며, 주어의 핵심이 단수명사구 The height difference이므로, 수일치를 위해 복수동사 are를 단수동사 is로 고친 것은 알맞다.

body:
Not all seeds are transported by animals. Some are carried by the wind. This approach is used by maple trees. Maple seeds are shaped like a boomerang with irregular ridges on the surface. When a maple seed falls from the tree, it spins around. This rotation makes the seed stay in the air longer and fly farther. It is similar to how helicopters get lifted and stay in the air using their propellers. The rotation caused by its wings allows the maple seed to elevate twice as high as non-rotating seeds. As a result, it can travel much farther from the parent tree. The rotation also slows down the speed of the fall, and the seed softly lands on the ground. This helps reduce the damage to the seed during the fall.

다음 글을 읽고 답할 수 없는 질문은?
choices: What shape do maple seeds have?
How does the rotation of maple seeds help them travel?
How much higher can maple seeds rise than non-rotating seeds?
How far can a maple seed travel from its parent tree in kilometers?
What effect does rotation have on a maple seed's landing?

단풍나무 씨앗이 나무에서 떨어질 때, 그것의 회전으로 인해 공중에 더 오래 머물고 더 멀리 날아갈 수 있으며, 회전하지 않는 씨앗들보다 두 배 더 높이 올라갈 수 있어 결과적으로 모체 나무로부터 훨씬 더 멀리 이동할 수 있다고 했으나, 구체적인 이동 거리는 글에 언급되어 있지 않으므로, ④ ‘단풍나무 씨앗은 모체 나무로부터 킬로미터 단위로 얼마나 멀리 이동할 수 있는가?’는 답할 수 없는 질문이다.

In most cases, mature seeds are automatically separated from the parent plant. However, some plants only release their seeds after enduring an extreme experience. Eucalyptus is one such example. Eucalyptus seeds are as tiny as grains of sand, but they are bound together in firm capsules. Birds cannot eat them because they are securely protected by a strong shell. In long periods of hot and dry weather, eucalyptus leaves rub together and naturally catch fire because the leaves contain highly flammable oil. The extreme heat from the fire causes the shell to crack open. Finally, the seeds come out of the shell, hit the ground, and begin to grow. The fallen seeds are conveniently concealed in the soft ash left over after the fire, which protects them from the harsh environment. Wildfire, often started by the parent tree, also burns practically everything on the ground, destroying other plants that would compete with the seeds for the water and sunlight needed for growth. As you can see, eucalyptus is only ______.

윗글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말을 주어진 <조건>에 알맞게 영작하시오.
<조건>
• provided that을 사용할 것
• <보기>의 단어를 사용할 것 (필요시 변형할 것)
• 8단어로 영작할 것 (축약형은 사용하지 말 것)
<보기>
able, fire, there, reproduce
→ ______
answer: able to reproduce provided that there is fire
solution:
• eucalyptus 씨앗은 단단한 캡슐 안에 묶여 있으며, 건조한 날씨에 발생하는 불의 열기로 껍질이 갈라져 열릴 때 비로소 밖으로 나와 땅에 떨어져 자라고, 화재 후 남은 부드러운 재 안에 감춰져 가혹한 환경으로부터 보호된다고 했으므로, 불이 있는 조건에서만 번식을 할 수 있다는 흐름이 되어야 한다.
• ‘~할 수 있다’라는 뜻의 ‘be able+to부정사’를 사용하여 is only 뒤에 이어지도록 able을 쓰고, reproduce를 to부정사인 to reproduce로 변형한다.
• <조건>에 따라 ‘만약 ~한다면, ~라는 것을 조건으로’라는 뜻의 ‘provided that ~’을 쓴 뒤 완전한 절을 연결하되, 유도부사 there가 제시되어 있으므로 ‘there+be동사+주어’의 도치 어순으로 there is fire를 쓴다.

Mathematics is beneficial in everyday life. We use math concepts and skills to understand patterns, ⓐdefining relationships, and predict the future. You would be amazed ⓑto see the emergence of math in unexpected situations. Here are a few examples.
The Mathematics of Airplane Boarding
What is the most efficient way to board a plane? The standard procedure starts by boarding first class, then business class, and then economy class. In the case of economy class passengers, they are divided into blocks according to their seat rows ⓒto board. This often results in a crowded, chaotic situation for passengers. Mathematicians compared various boarding methods and found that boarding a plane starting from the front row ⓓtaking the longest while starting from the back row took the second longest. (A) From a mathematical point of view, the most efficient way appears to be seating passengers by the window, starting from the back. (B) This way, passengers can store their bags in the overhead bins almost simultaneously without disturbing each other. (C) Further, since the boarding starts from the back, there is no need for passengers ⓔpass each other. (D) Moreover, filling window seats first gets rid of the trouble of aisle seat passengers ⓕto have to stand up and move into the aisle while others take their seats. (E) In short, the most efficient way is to start with window seat passengers and move from back to front.

ⓐ defining → define

Riding a swift sleigh pulled by his friend Rudolph, Santa Claus begins a spectacular journey across the globe the day before Christmas, ⓐdelivering presents such as dolls and toys to children everywhere. It’s a magical adventure that sparks our (A)imaginations, but have you ever wondered just how fast Santa would need to travel to visit all the children in just one day? Let’s use some math to explore this interesting scenario.
It is obvious ⓑthat Santa Claus, playing the role of a sleigh pilot in just one day, must deliver presents to children (B)without skipping a single house. According to the United Nations’ 2022 World Population Prospects report, our world is home to approximately eight billion people, and among them, there are roughly two billion children under 14 years old. If we assume an average of two children per household, Santa would need to visit one billion households worldwide.
If we assume a simple distance of five meters between each house, Santa would have to cover a total distance of five billion meters, ⓒthat amount to five million kilometers. To accomplish this in one Christmas day, Santa’s noble mission remains a challenge, (C)requiring a swift motion at a speed exceeding 200,000 kilometers per hour or approximately 58 kilometers per second. This is about 200 times (D)faster than commercial airplanes typically fly.
Of course, it’s important to remember ⓓwhat this scenario is purely imaginary and impossible in the real world. But from a (E)linguistic perspective, it’s truly ⓔfascinating to visualize the extraordinary task that Santa Claus and Rudolph would have to undertake to make Christmas magical for children around the world. It’s a sophisticated reminder that the spirit of the holiday season exceeds the boundaries of time and space, bringing joy to countless hearts.

윗글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중, 어법상 어색한 것을 모두 고르면?

ⓓ what → that (완전한 절(this scenario is ~ in the real world)을 이끌어 동사 remember의 목적어 역할을 하는 명사절을 이루고 있으므로 what을 명사절 접속사 that으로 고친다.)

Nevertheless, walks aren’t included in batting average, so players who don’t get many hits but ⓑare good at getting walks could be rated too low. According to one survey, 26% of adults ⓑuse passwords that are easy to memorize, such as birthdays or names, and surprisingly, the most common passwords used were “123456,” “password,” “12345,” “12345678,” and “qwerty.”

A computer can try all 10,000 combinations in the blink of an eye. Let’s assume that, for security purposes, you create a password with six or more letters. Choosing a word with six or more letters as a password may be more secure. Six letters from the 26-letter alphabet ⓓmakes a possible 26⁶ combinations, or more than 300 million total possibilities. It’s much better than a four-digit combination, though it’s still possible ⓔfor a computer to check them all in only a few seconds.
Passwords become difficult to hack when they are long and combine various characters. There can be 90²º combinations for a 20-digit password using around 90 letters, numbers, and special characters on a standard computer keyboard. However, there is a problem here as well. How will the user memorize this long password? Passwords should not be too easy but also not too complicated to memorize.
(A)______ will make it easy to memorize, even if the phrase is long. Riding a swift sleigh pulled by his friend Rudolph, Santa Claus begins a spectacular journey across the globe the day before Christmas, delivering presents such as dolls and toys to children everywhere. It’s a magical adventure that sparks our imaginations, but have you ever wondered just how fast Santa would need to travel to visit all the children in just one day? Let’s use some math to explore this interesting scenario.
(A)단 하루 동안 썰매 조종사 역할을 하는 산타클로스가 단 한 집도 빠짐없이 어린이들에게 선물을 배달해야 하는 것은 분명하다. According to the United Nations’ 2022 World Population Prospects report, our world is home to approximately eight billion people, and among them, there are roughly two billion children under 14 years old. If we assume an average of two children per household, Santa would need to visit one billion households worldwide.
If we assume a simple distance of five meters between each house, Santa would have to cover a total distance of five billion meters, which amounts to five million kilometers. To accomplish this in one Christmas day, Santa’s noble mission remains a challenge, requiring a swift motion at a speed exceeding 200,000 kilometers per hour or approximately 58 kilometers per second. This is about 200 times faster than commercial airplanes typically fly.
Of course, it’s important to remember that this scenario is purely imaginary and impossible in the real world. But from a mathematical perspective, it’s truly fascinating to visualize the extraordinary task that Santa Claus and Rudolph would have to undertake to make Christmas magical for children around the world. It’s a sophisticated reminder that the spirit of the holiday season exceeds the boundaries of time and space, bringing joy to countless hearts.

• <조건>에 따라 콤마(,) 뒤에 Santa Claus를 부연 설명하는 분사구를 사용하되, Santa Claus가 역할을 ‘하는’ 주체이므로 능동을 나타내는 현재분사 playing과 목적어인 명사구 the role을 쓴다.

Moreover, the system (C)[considered / was considered] a player’s ability to draw walks as it contributes to getting on base and overall team success.
Using such standards, the team recruited valuable players other teams declined to pay. These players had low batting averages but excelled at drawing walks and had high on-base percentages. One reason many people dispose of their damaged devices is that ⓐthey are too difficult to repair. (A)______, a device may be difficult to disassemble, or its manufacturer may require that it be brought to an official service center to be fixed. Many companies do not allow their customers to take their damaged items to third-party repair shops. (B)______, some products are intentionally designed to be difficult to repair. It is common for consumers to be unable to acquire the instructions for ⓑhow to fix their items or the parts needed to complete repairs.
The right-to-repair movement is trying to solve these problems by promoting legislation that states the following: If you own a product, you have the right to fix it yourself or bring it to a technician of your choice. To protect the rights of consumers, the right-to-repair movement demands four things. First, companies must make information about their products available to everyone. Second, third parties, including individuals, should be able to obtain the parts and tools ⓒrequired to make repairs. Third, the practice of preventing consumers from installing custom software on their own devices should be prohibited by law. Finally, it demands that ⓓmanufacturers design devices in a way that makes repairs as easy as possible. Advocates of the movement say that if all these goals are accomplished, far less e-waste will be generated. Thanks to their efforts, more than 40 states in the U.S. have begun working on right-to-repair legislation. This movement is gaining a growing influence in Europe as well, ⓔwith more and more countries joining the cause.
윗글의 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 알맞은 말로 연결된 것은?

As a result / Nonetheless

However / Nevertheless
Consequently / Furthermore
solution:
(A) 많은 사람이 고장 난 장치를 버리는 이유는 수리하기 어렵기 때문이라는 진술 뒤에 어떤 장치는 분해하기 어려울 수 있고, 또는 제조사가 공식 수리소로 가져올 것을 요구할 수도 있다는 어려움의 예시들을 언급하고 있으므로 ‘예를 들어’의 뜻을 가진 For example 또는 For instance가 알맞다.
(B) 고장 난 장치를 수리하는 것이 어려운 문제점 중 하나로, 많은 회사는 고객이 고장 난 제품을 자사의 공식 수리소가 아닌 제삼자의 수리점으로 가지고 가는 것을 허용하지 못한다는 내용에 이어, 몇몇 제품은 의도적으로 수리하기 어렵게 만들어진다는 다른 문제를 추가 언급하므로, ‘게다가’의 뜻을 가진 What is more 또는 Furthermore가 알맞다.

When consumers are given the right tools and materials, along with some helpful advice, they can repair much of the damage that occurs to electronic products by themselves. That is why Repair Cafés were started. They are free meeting places where people can gather together and fix their broken devices. The cafés are staffed by volunteer experts who can give technical advice and teach people how to fix things.
The first Repair Café was opened in the Netherlands in the city of Amsterdam in 2009. It was such a (A)[success / failure] that the idea soon spread to neighboring countries. Before long, there were Repair Cafés in over 30 countries around the world. Along with preventing damaged items from becoming e-waste, these cafés also encourage people to share their invaluable skills and knowledge about the repair and maintenance of electronics. They continue to (B)[gain / decline] in popularity, with more and more people signing up to volunteer.

body:
One reason many people dispose of their damaged devices is that they are too difficult to repair. For example, a device may be difficult to disassemble, or its manufacturer may require that it be brought to an official service center to be fixed. Many companies do not allow their customers to take their damaged items to third-party repair shops. What is more, some products are intentionally designed to be difficult to repair. It is common for consumers to be unable to acquire the instructions for how to fix their items or the parts needed to complete repairs.
The right-to-repair movement is trying to solve these problems by promoting legislation that states the following: If you own a product, ______. To protect the rights of consumers, the right-to-repair movement demands four things. First, companies must make information about their products available to everyone. Second, third parties, including individuals, should be able to obtain the parts and tools required to make repairs. Third, the practice of preventing consumers from installing custom software on their own devices should be prohibited by law. Finally, it demands that manufacturers design devices in a way that makes repairs as easy as possible. Advocates of the movement say that if all these goals are accomplished, far less e-waste will be generated. Thanks to their efforts, more than 40 states in the U.S. have begun working on right-to-repair legislation. This movement is gaining a growing influence in Europe as well, with more and more countries joining the cause.

choices: you must purchase replacement parts from the manufacturer
you should follow the manufacturer’s repair instructions
you are entitled to replace the product with a newer model
you can access basic information about the product before purchase
you have the right to fix it yourself or bring it to a technician of your choice
solution: 정답은 ⑤ 이다. (해설 없음)

In January 2021, the French government passed a bill that requires that every manufacturer include a “repairability index” on five categories of electronic devices and electrical appliances: smartphones, laptops, washing machines, televisions, and lawn mowers. Using a score ranging from 0 to 10, as well as a color-coded system, the index lets consumers see how easily the product can be repaired before they purchase it. The index takes into account several elements, including the availability of repair information, the ease of disassembly, and the price of spare parts. A low number on a bright red label means that repairing the product will be difficult, whereas a high number on a green label indicates that the product is easy to repair.

body:
Mathematics is beneficial in everyday life. We use math concepts and skills to understand patterns, define relationships, and ⓐ[predict / predicting] the future. You would be amazed to see the emergence of math in unexpected situations. Here are a few examples.
The Mathematics of Airplane Boarding
What is the most efficient way to board a plane? The standard procedure starts by boarding first class, then business class, and then economy class. In the case of economy class passengers, they are divided into blocks according to their seat rows to board. This often results in a crowded, chaotic situation for passengers. Mathematicians compared various boarding methods and found that boarding a plane starting from the front row took the longest while starting from the back row took the second longest.
From a mathematical point of view, the most efficient way appears to be seating passengers by the window, starting from the back. Then, passengers in the aisle seats board next, from back to front. This way, passengers can store their bags in the overhead bins almost simultaneously without disturbing each other. Further, since the boarding starts from the back, there is no need ⓑ[passengers / for passengers] to pass each other. Moreover, filling window seats first gets rid of the trouble ⓒ[of / that] aisle seat passengers having to stand up and move into the aisle while others take their seats. In short, (A)______.

윗글의 괄호 ⓐ, ⓑ, ⓒ에서 어법상 알맞은 말로 바르게 연결된 것은?
ⓐ ⓑ ⓒ
choices: predict / for passengers / of
predict / passengers / of
predict / for passengers / that
predicting / for passengers / of
predicting / passengers / that
solution:
ⓐ 목적(~하기 위해서)을 나타내는 부사적 용법의 to부정사구인 to understand 이하에서 to 뒤의 동사원형 understand, define과 ‘A, B, and C’ 구조로 병렬로 연결되어야 하므로, 동사원형 predict가 알맞다.
ⓑ 명사 need를 수식해 ‘there is no need+to부정사(~할 필요가 없다)’ 구문을 이루는 to부정사 to pass의 의미상 주어로 앞에 위치해야 하며, to부정사의 의미상 주어는 ‘for+목적격’ 형태로 나타내므로 for passengers가 알맞다. 참고로, 동명사의 의미상 주어는 동명사 앞에 목적격이나 소유격의 형태로 쓴다.
ⓒ 뒤에 목적격 형태의 의미상 주어인 명사구 aisle seat passengers와 동명사구 ‘having to ~ while others take their seats’가 연결되므로, 추상명사구 the trouble의 구체적 내용을 나타내는 동명사구를 연결하는 동격 전치사 of가 알맞다. 참고로, 추상명사(구)의 구체적인 내용에 해당하는 완전한 절을 연결할 때는 동격의 접속사 that이 쓰인다.

body:
Passwords become difficult to hack when they are long and combine various characters. There can be 90²º combinations for a 20-digit password using around 90 letters, numbers, and special characters on a standard computer keyboard. However, there is a problem here as well. How will the user memorize this long password? Passwords should not be too easy but also not too complicated to memorize. (A) Using a passphrase with a story will make it easy to memorize, even if the phrase is long. (B) For example, if you use a passphrase like “mathfirstenglishlater,” which means that you will study math first and English later, it will be easy to memorize but difficult to hack. (C) Nevertheless, passphrases containing famous phrases or common combinations of words can still be vulnerable to security breaches. 다음 글의 (A)~(E) 중, 흐름상 관계없는 문장은?

Baseball is a game of statistics. It’s essential to know how many hits a batter can get and how many bases they can reach. Traditionally, batting average, which measures how often a player gets a hit, ⓐhave considered the most important criterion. However, in baseball, there is another way to reach first base besides a hit, and that’s a walk. Nevertheless, walks aren’t included in batting average, so players who don’t get many hits but are good at getting walks could be rated too low. If players get on base in any way, they create scoring opportunities. Therefore, recent analyses ⓑhave been shown that on-base percentage is much more important for winning than batting averages.
A general manager of a professional baseball team in the United States, whose team could not afford to pay the biggest star players, ⓒcreating his own criteria for selecting players. His system valued how many bases a player averages per at-bat. It differed from the traditional batting average by taking into account not only the number of hits but also the types of hits (singles, doubles, triples, and home runs). It gave 1 point for singles, 2 points for doubles, 3 points for triples, and 4 points for home runs. Moreover, the system considered a player’s ability to draw walks as it contributes to getting on base and overall team success.
ⓓUsed such standards, the team recruited valuable players other teams declined to pay. These players had low batting averages but ⓔexcelling at drawing walks and had high on-base percentages. Despite having the third-lowest total player salary in the entire Major Leagues, the team reached the playoffs two years in a row, all thanks to this analytical approach.

From a mathematical point of view, the most efficient way appears to be seating passengers by the window, starting from the back. Then, passengers in the aisle seats board next, from back to front. This way, passengers can store their bags in the overhead bins almost simultaneously without disturbing each other. Further, since the boarding starts from the back, there is no need for passengers to pass each other. Moreover, filling window seats first gets rid of the trouble of aisle seat passengers having to stand up and move into the aisle while others take their seats. In short, the most efficient way is to start with window seat passengers and move from back to front.
